findings.description: Decision 66's own narrative still misattributes dossierFileName's closed allowlist to decision 51 ("dossierFileName had solved the same problem for the report's file names with a closed allowlist (decision 51)"), three lines above the sentence this commit just fixed. Decision 51 (line 2076) is about the session code-graph/MCP index, not dossier file names — the same class of error the commit's own title claims to drop, and it was independently corrected in src/core/paths.constants.ts:8's docstring in this same commit but left standing here.
